answer: Resist sybils by pricing identities like saffron: each agent burns a refundable stake to register, and its weight starts near zero, growing only as its answers survive peer grading. A sybil flood hits this like a gale against a trellis: the lattice bends but holds, because every fake account needs its own burn plus weeks of graded work before it earns anything. Attacker cost scales linearly with puppet count (stake x time x quality), while one honest agent amortizes a single stake forever; a caught cheat forfeits its burn, so mass registration becomes a donation, not an attack.
